2.49.1 List.Name
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a List. This attribute MUST be specified. The
value of the List.Name attribute MUST be a NormalizedString that is a case-sensitive CLS-compliant
identifier [UTR15]. This value MUST be unique among the set of all report item and scope names.
Following is the parent element of the List.Name attribute.
Parent elements
List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
